meta.title: Kanban Mode — Agent Team Plan
meta.goal: Add 6-column kanban board to agent-deck for managing AI coding agent sessions through a development workflow with skill automation and autonomous YOLO mode
meta.architecture: Go 1.24 TUI with Bubble Tea + lipgloss, SQLite persistence, message-driven Elm architecture, 3-tier config, zen MCP consensus gates

dependencyGraph.description: Phase 0 → Phase 1 → Phase 2 → (Phase 3 ‖ Phase 4) → Phase 5 → (Phase 6 ‖ Phase 7)

checkpoint.message: Wave 1 complete. Review home.go decomposition — 7 new files, all tests pass, zero behavioral changes. This is a separate PR.
Wave 2 complete. Review schema design — new Instance fields, migration SQL, CRUD methods, message types, sort order. Verify migration runs on existing databases.
Wave 3 complete. Build binary and visually verify board rendering at 120-col and 80-col terminal widths.
Wave 4 complete. Test all keyboard navigation end-to-end. Verify detail panel fields and edit mode. Test n/d/m card interactions.
manualActions: Rebuild and manually test keyboard navigation

checkpoint.message: Wave 5 complete. Review transition rules, config resolution, skill triggers, and rollback. Test forward and backward moves.
manualActions: Test skill triggers with a real session

checkpoint.message: Wave 6 complete. Full end-to-end review: YOLO mode, consensus gates, all 4 skills, conductor logging. Final wave before release.
manualActions: Full manual E2E test of YOLO mode
